prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one production Minecraft Java inventory item sprite for the Darkspawn mod, designed to read at exactly 32x32 pixels.
Style: dark fantasy native Minecraft pixel art. Chunky deliberate square pixel clusters, limited palette, a strong one-logical-pixel charcoal outline with a subtle deep violet undertone in darkest shadows. Simple three-tone material shading with a top-left highlight. Crisp, solid physical object, not painterly concept art.
Composition: SINGLE centered isolated item on a square canvas. Occupy 80-86% of the square with clear transparent margins. Draw like an actual 32x32 sprite enlarged using nearest-neighbor scaling: large square pixel steps and compact readable detail. Maintain a strong silhouette when shrunk.
Background: real alpha transparency. No scene, floor, drop shadow, labels, letters, numbers, inventory box, frame, logo, watermark, extra objects, tiny floating fragments, soft bloom, gradients, smooth curves or photorealism. Any luminous accents must remain inside the object silhouette.
Framing requirement: the entire object, including every outline pixel, must fit inside the central 80% of BOTH canvas width and height. Leave a completely transparent 10% margin on every side. Keep all tips inside these margins.
Subject: Fossil Tyrant Essence, an earned boss crafting drop. ONE thick asymmetric upward-pointing amber crystal shard partially embedded in a chunky broken dark sandstone base, with two ivory fossil tooth fragments embedded along one edge of the amber. Broad orange-gold translucent-looking facets rendered with solid pixel tones, cream-yellow upper-left highlight, burnt ochre and dark umber shadows. Strong raw triangular mineral silhouette, taller than wide, visibly distinct from a round summoning talisman or a heart. Do not add floating shards, a ring, a pendant bail, lettering or an external aura.
packaging: 32x32 RGBA, Pillow BOX resize, alpha cutout at 128; transparent background retained
